AnswerQuery: select p1.pizza_type_id, p1.size as size_1, p2.size as size_2, p1.price as price_1, p2.price as price_2, (p2.price - p1.price) as price_difference from pizzas p1 join pizzas p2 on p1.pizza_type_id = p2.pizza_type_id and p1.size != p2.size order by p1.pizza_type_id, p1.size;
